title: ESCAPE SUCCESSFUL
body: You burst through the emergency exit as the facility goes into full lockdown. Fresh air. Sirens fade behind you. You made it out.

title: TIME EXPIRED
body: The automated lockdown sequence completes. Blast doors seal every corridor. You're trapped inside as the ventilation system begins its purge cycle. Next time, move faster.

title: SECURITY RESPONSE
body: Red lights flood the corridor. You hear boots on the stairwell. The security response team arrives in under a minute. You don't reach the exit in time.

title: SHADOW EXIT
body: The maintenance hatch swings open to reveal daylight. You slip out through the forgotten tunnel. No logs. No cameras. No one will ever know you were here.
